idea-plugin.name: Jenkinsfile Free
idea-plugin.description:
Free Jenkinsfile editor for GoLand and IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Recognizes any filename containing jenkinsfile, regardless of letter case or file extension.

Includes Groovy and Jenkins Pipeline syntax highlighting, embedded shell, Windows batch, and PowerShell highlighting in sh, bat/cmd, powershell, and pwsh script literals, grammar checks, context-aware completion, named-field highlighting, an outline in the Structure view, Jenkins GDSL import, and idempotent formatting.

Formats with Ctrl+Shift+L (or the IDE Reformat Code action). Normalizes whitespace, separates Pipeline sections, and formats long named arguments one field per line. Safe sh, bat/cmd, and PowerShell literals are split into readable multiline scripts; existing multiline scripts are formatted in place. Ambiguous shell constructs are left unchanged. Repeated formatting produces the same result.

The plugin works offline and does not collect or upload source code. Source and license: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Format safe sh, Windows batch (bat/cmd), and PowerShell scripts as readable multiline literals, with long options on separate continuation lines.
  • Format existing multiline scripts in place and keep repeated formatting idempotent.
  • Leave control-flow blocks, comments, redirects, heredocs, and other ambiguous shell syntax unchanged.
  • Retain embedded script highlighting, named-field highlighting, and case-insensitive filename detection.
